name: Zeppelin Wars [ALPHA 0.69D]
desc:
Version: Alpha 0.75

Inspired by myrkrwarrior's classic "Zeppelin Battle" from 2008, Zeppelin Wars seeks to recreate a game where you can battle it out in the skies. 

Victory or certain death? Patrol or Pirate? Zeppelin crew or pilot? The choice is yours to make.
